notes.pricePolicy: Price is shown only for official direct-sale or Hat Shop rotation rows. Other historical cost values remain hidden because they are not current purchase options.
notes.imagePolicy: Use the official per-item thumbnail supplied in the discovery index. Source thumbnail URLs are kept only in the separate image manifest.
